metadata.description: Claude Code agents, skills and commands for the ShockLab group

plugins.name: shocklab-core
plugins.description: Check the ShockLab knowledge base before working out org-specific procedures, and record new findings

plugins.name: shocklab-figures
plugins.description: figure-master agent: makes, restyles, copies and recreates figures for LaTeX reports, theses and papers in ShockLab's MATLAB plotting style

plugins.name: shocklab-library
plugins.description: Paper-library skills for Library_of_Shock_Lab: /lit, /research-question, /add-paper and /paper-audit (plus the paper-auditor agent) and /update-topics (revise topic pages from their queues and apply queued note updates, claiming each page and note first) for everyone; /restructure-note (plus the note-restructurer agent) for maintainers; /schedule-library-processing books an unattended overnight run of add-paper, paper-audit or update-topics for anyone; /library-status reports what is queued (topic queues, note updates, the audit queue, Market papers waiting or not yet filed, library health) for anyone

plugins.name: shocklab-apps
plugins.description: App feature queue: /queue requests into an app's FEATURE_QUEUE.md, then /enact-queue builds them in one version bump
